question: Among players taller than 180 cm, identify those whose crossing score is above the average crossing score of all players with height > 180 and who also have a preferred foot of 'right'. Return their player names, crossing scores, and overall ratings, ordered by crossing score descending and then by overall rating descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p."XCL_123" AS player_name, pa."XCL_137" AS crossing_score, pa."XCL_132" AS overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE p."XCL_126" > 180
  AND pa."XCL_134" = 'right'
  AND pa."XCL_137" > (
      SELECT AVG(pa2."XCL_137")
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
      JOIN Player AS p2 ON pa2."XCL_130" = p2."XCL_122"
      WHERE p2."XCL_126" > 180
  )
ORDER BY pa."XCL_137" DESC, pa."XCL_132" DESC;

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT p."XCL_123" AS player_name, pa."XCL_137" AS crossing_score, pa."XCL_132" AS overall_rating
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE p."XCL_126" > 180
  AND pa."XCL_134" = 'right'
  AND pa."XCL_137" > (
      SELECT AVG(pa2."XCL_137")
      FROM Player_Attributes AS pa2
      JOIN Player AS p2 ON pa2."XCL_130" = p2."XCL_122"
      WHERE p2."XCL_126" > 180
  )
ORDER BY pa."XCL_137" DESC, pa."XCL_132" DESC;
